title: BEACON: Benchmark for Comprehensive RNA Tasks and Language Models

layout.note: Five lettered zones on white, each titled by a wide grey pill: three on the top row (task crosshair, database logo wall, baseline boxes) and two below (a wide task-illustration strip and two metric cards). Letters run a, b, d, c, e by position.

lesson: Pin the benchmark name at the origin of a crosshair whose axes are the two task dimensions, place task names in the quadrants and colour them by data size with a four-dot key; titled pills then turn the rest into parallel zones for data, models and metrics.
